name: The Honking Deep (eldritch goose boss)
scale_note: Boss scale against the 1.80 m reference human: 5.1 m to the tips of the main head's quill crest (crown of the head about 4.95 m), 8.5 m across from finger-claw to finger-claw. Faces -Y, +Z up, origin on the ground between the feet. All design numbers below are metres in that frame.
budget_note: Hero asset: about 30x the scythe prop's budget. Every eye, tooth, sucker and feather is real geometry, not a texture.

materials.name: PlumageBrown
materials.notes: back and wing coverts, the Canada goose's brown

materials.notes: pale feather-edge bars on the flanks

materials.name: FleshViolet
materials.notes: wet flesh: tentacles, eyelids, maw lips

materials.notes: the throat of the breast maw

body_rings.note: [y, z_centre, half_width, half_height] from breast to tail tip

side_neck.note: the +X neck; the -X one is its mirror

wing.note: the +X wing, raised in a threat display; the -X one is its mirror

build: Body: lofted ellipse rings, about 3.7 m long, 1.88 m wide, lowest point 1.06 m; brown back, narrow pale bars on the flanks, tan breast (straight seam at y = -0.42 m), white belly and undertail.

Necks: one main S-neck from the breast to 4.7 m, radius 0.36 m tapering to 0.165 m; two side necks out to +/-1.36 m, radius 0.26 to 0.13 m. All black, a ridge of 13 bone spines down the back of the main neck, glowing eyes along every neck (8 main, 4 per side neck).
Heads: goose heads with the white chinstrap, three glowing eyes a side, beaks gaping (42 deg main, 58 deg side) with rows of teeth on both mandibles and a spiked tongue. Side heads at 0.74 scale.
Breast maw: a vertical mouth 0.34 m wide x 0.84 m tall on the breast, violet lips, 22 teeth around the rim, dark throat.

Wings: raised and spread, 8.5 m across including the bare finger bones, arm 0.17 m to 0.04 m thick; 10 ragged primaries 1.45 to 1.05 m, 12 secondaries, 5 tertials, two covert rows; two finger bones 1.25 m long with claws break out past the primaries; six glowing eyes along each leading edge.
Legs: black, hip 1.55 m to ankle; three webbed toes 0.48 m long spread 32 deg, bone claws, a small back toe.
Tentacles: six from under the belly, 0.14 m at the root to 0.015 m; four arch out and coil on the ground, two rise and curl; one staggered row of red suckers each (250 in all).
Tail: nine black feathers 0.9 m long in a cupped fan over 80 deg, outer feathers banked and drooping so the fan reads from the side.
Spines: a bone ridge along the back and down the main neck; a crest of quills behind each head.
